newsitem.title: USA: Lydall sees 96 EPS below projections.
newsitem.headline: Lydall sees 96 EPS below projections.

text.p: Lydall Inc said Friday the second half of 1996 is proving to be less robust than the company had expected, and it is tracking below its projections for 1996 of earnings per share of about $1.41 and sales in the range of $265 million.
Lydall issued a statement saying it expects to earn more in the range of $1.35 to $1.36 per share with sales slightly ahead of last year's sales of $252.1 million.
Looking ahead, Lydall said it has many growth opportunities on the horizon and sees this period of slower growth as temporary
